request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:EGG

layers.text: Change only the colours: the red painted band round the egg is removed, leaving plain warm cream shell; the grey-blue speckles become big bold solid bright orange speckles, colour #fe6d00; the red cloth of the nest becomes a nest of pale cream bones and dry tan straw. Nothing red and nothing blue is left. Keep the egg's shape and size, the nest's shape, the thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
